sample_reviews: I am disappointed with how Airbnb handled my missing payout. Airbnb confirmed that the payout had been released, but the funds never reached my bank account. Despite multiple contacts with customer support, I was repeatedly directed back and forth between Airbnb and my bank, with no clear resolution. The process was stressful, time-consuming, and lacked transparency. As a host, I expect reliable payout tracking process and stronger support when payout issues arise.

There's no reason to use Airbnb anymore. When it first came out prices were cheaper than hotels. Nowadays, Airbnbs cost as much as if not more than hotels do, plus for far worse service. I've been in situations where I'm in a foreign country, got to my Airbnb at night, and discovered the host double booked the place. Airbnb support is surprisingly unhelpful. No reimbursements for anything, they'll just cancel your booking. If you need to find another hotel, that's on you. Stick with hotels

I have good reviews on Airbnb from the hosts I've been. Recently, I booked a place in Batangas, this happened in the the middle of typhoon, we were far from home. The airbnb host told me that they don't have electricity after I already paid for my reservation. I cancelled the reservation because they cannot promise that the electricity will be restored and they don't have anything to do if it is not restored. Airbnb said it will take 3-5 business days to receive the refund, we don't have money.
root_cause: Poor payout tracking process and support
pm_action: Improve payout tracking and customer support
